candidate_practices.name: Name the assumption being changed
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts identify a specific restriction and describe the structure or setting that replaces it.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes novelty assessable as a technical change without requiring a priority claim.
candidate_practices.application: Replace 'a novel framework' with the existing restriction, the proposed alternative, and its validity conditions.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not invent a restrictive assumption when the contribution is principally a resource or empirical observation.

support.specific_example: ScaleGMN adds activation-dependent scaling symmetries to the permutation-focused framing of network processing.
Do Finetti moves to exchangeable data under independent causal mechanisms and introduces a corresponding factorization.
BLM replaces one-to-one label correspondence with an iteratively updated probabilistic mapping matrix.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Exact validity conditions, fidelity of the prior-work characterization, and whether the replacement preserves required properties.

candidate_practices.name: Connect each design change to its intended effect
candidate_practices.source_observation: The abstracts associate named components or execution changes with particular reconstruction, training, or efficiency objectives.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: a reader can distinguish the design rationale from an unexplained component inventory.
candidate_practices.application: Rewrite the method sentence as 'component/change performs X, supporting Y'; present empirical attribution separately.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Avoid assigning independent effects to tightly coupled components when the available evidence supports only a joint mechanism.

support.specific_example: NeuroClips conditions video diffusion with semantic keyframes and reconstructed low-level perceptual flows.
E2E-MFD answers complex training processes with one training phase and synchronous optimization.
YOCO explains cache construction and reuse separately from its early-exit prefilling computation.
Schedule-Free connects scheduling and iterate averaging while specifying removal of stopping-step dependence and no extra hyperparameters.

contrasts.contrast: VASA describes holistic dynamics generation in a shared face latent space; separate desired qualities need not imply separate modules.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Whether component effects are isolated, operational simplification is measured, and claimed execution equivalence holds.

candidate_practices.name: Report quality with its operating conditions
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts accompany performance claims with output specifications, model size, or training-token budgets.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the conditions clarify what capability or resource comparison the result actually supports.
candidate_practices.application: Attach the relevant resolution, throughput, size, or training budget to the result; identify the comparator and evaluation stage.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not substitute an available proxy such as gate count or token count for an unmeasured runtime or energy claim.

support.specific_example: VASA reports online 512×512 generation at up to 40 FPS alongside qualitative dynamics claims.
Logic-gate networks pair 86.29% CIFAR-10 accuracy with 61 million gates and a reported 29× size reduction.
Rho-1 separates continual-pretraining gains, post-finetuning MATH scores, and general-task results with their token contexts.

contrasts.contrast: Federated Q-learning characterizes asymptotic sample–communication costs through bounds, requiring formal conditions rather than a deployment measurement.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Hardware, budget accounting, baseline matching, absolute scores, and percentage denominators.

candidate_practices.name: Choose a measurement unit that answers the question
candidate_practices.source_observation: These evaluation abstracts introduce response patterns, module errors, calculation stages, or incremental progress beyond endpoint accuracy.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: the chosen unit can expose distinctions that an aggregate score cannot express.
candidate_practices.application: State the unresolved question first, then name the measurement unit that can distinguish its possible answers.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not decompose outcomes into categories that cannot be reliably observed or compared.

support.specific_example: DevBench compares child, adult, and model response patterns across language abilities rather than relying on absolute performance.
Embodied Agent Interface formalizes module inputs and outputs and distinguishes hallucination, affordance, and planning errors.
MedCalc-Bench supplies solution steps and reports extraction, equation-selection, and arithmetic failures.
AgentBoard adds progress rate and interactive visualization to address limited insight from final success.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Metric definitions, annotation reliability, error interactions, and validation of the intended interpretation.

candidate_practices.name: Make resource contents part of the contribution
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts identify what their resources contain or align, alongside construction methods or accompanying analyses.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: concrete contents explain the resource contribution without requiring an algorithmic novelty claim.
candidate_practices.application: Describe the resource unit, attached information, construction provenance, and one supported analysis or use.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not imply that resource scale, release, or a demonstration establishes broad effectiveness.

support.specific_example: Stylus couples description improvement and retrieval with StylusDocs, containing 75K adapters and precomputed embeddings.
OpenMathInstruct specifies 1.8M Mixtral-generated problem–solution pairs, a trained model demonstration, and a planned permissive release.
Brain Treebank aligns intracranial recordings with corrected transcripts, word onsets, and dependency parses, then analyzes electrode sensitivity.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Construction quality, alignment accuracy, accessibility, licensing terms, and whether demonstrations depend on additional data.

candidate_practices.name: Turn intended scope into explicit design dimensions
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts specify environmental, cultural, participant, or lifecycle dimensions in their resource or study designs.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: explicit dimensions let readers judge the scope of the question against the scope of the collected evidence.
candidate_practices.application: Replace 'comprehensive' or 'diverse' with the dimensions sampled, their role in the question, and any bounded representativeness claim.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not treat breadth counts as evidence of balanced sampling or population representativeness.

support.specific_example: ChaosBench combines Earth-system variables, physics-based metrics, and forecasts from four agencies for the S2S setting.
CVQA addresses culturally narrow imagery through culturally grounded collection, reporting countries, languages, scripts, and question count.
PRISM links participant profiles to contextual feedback and limits its census-representative claim to UK and US samples.
The fair-dataset taxonomy organizes interviews with 30 curators around lifecycle challenges and trade-offs before systemic recommendations.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Sampling procedures, coverage distributions, taxonomy derivation, and whether recommendations extend beyond the evidence.

candidate_practices.name: State the rival explanation behind a comparison
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts name an interpretive ambiguity and describe comparisons intended to investigate it.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: a comparison becomes informative about an explanation, not merely a ranking.
candidate_practices.application: Name the alternative explanation, the comparison intended to distinguish it, and the narrower conclusion supported.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: Do not describe a correlation or context-removal comparison as conclusively identifying a mechanism.

support.specific_example: The evaluator study distinguishes self-preference from self-recognition, reporting recognition accuracy, finetuning correlations, and controls.
LingOly pairs accuracy with a no-context baseline to investigate performance beyond memorisation.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Control construction, remaining confounders, contamination evidence, and which causal or reasoning claims the comparisons justify.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Present a lower bound and constructive result as a joint characterization.
unusual_but_useful.application: State the necessary communication cost, then the algorithm's matching resource guarantees under aligned assumptions.
unusual_but_useful.limit: The abstract does not establish that definitions and conditions match.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Give a formalism both an illustrative model and an inferential procedure.
unusual_but_useful.application: Explain what the Pólya-urn-style illustration reveals separately from what the discovery–estimation algorithm computes.
unusual_but_useful.limit: An illustration does not establish algorithmic guarantees.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: Every abstract needs a gap–method–numerical-gain sequence.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Architecture-first, theory, resource, and qualitative-study narratives supply different contribution structures.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: A benchmark must demonstrate a better model.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Diagnostic findings or an evaluation interface can themselves be contributions.

discarded_generalizations.generalization: These practices explain Oral selection or validate ORAL.
discarded_generalizations.reason: Selected abstracts provide neither selection evidence nor a framework comparison.

source_checks_needed.issue: Check whether S2–S3 explicitly map qualities to evaluation axes; the extracted evidence names unspecified new metrics.
The optimal-convergence claim appears only in unknowns without a locator; locate it before reuse.
Check generator-license support in S2/S5; retain S7's planned-release tense.
Check whether S6's 24.7% denotes relative improvement or percentage points; do not reconstruct the baseline.
Verify S7's 128% SSIM and 81% spatiotemporal improvements, metric names, and denominators.
Check the exact clinical-effectiveness wording in S6; benchmark failures alone do not establish deployment thresholds.
Verify S3's scope concerning i.i.d. assumptions in traditional causal frameworks before generalizing.
Check whether S2/S5–S7 explicitly align every design choice with a difficulty; the one-to-one mapping may be extraction inference.
